D6E2.Settings.SecondEdition.Options.seco: Additional Skill modules
Each optional Skill module adds 2D to the character-creation Skill budget (Second Edition p. 20). Enter only modules actually used by this campaign.
Use Skill Specialization & Advanced Skills
Enable the optional Advanced Skill and Specialization structures from Second Edition pp. 96-99.
Use Module: Perks, Flaws & Talents
Enable native Second Edition feature creation accounting and typed feature services (pp. 101-129).
Use Module: Troubles & Assets
Enable Trouble and Asset invocation, Hero Point transactions, and GM-owned twice-per-session resets (pp. 130-131).
Use Module: Pips
Enable +1 and +2 Die Code modifiers, split-die character creation, and sequential pip advancement (Second Edition pp. 94-95). Core Second Edition otherwise uses whole dice.
Advancement strategy
Select exactly one automated Second Edition advancement module: Experience Points, Milestone rewards, or GM-approved Narrative arcs (Second Edition pp. 86-93).
